generaciones.prompt:
Create ONE polished, art-directed Instagram FEED launch poster for the Android music app MELODIA. Final composition must be VERTICAL 4:5, intended for 1080 x 1350 px export. NOT a story, NOT a landscape screenshot, NOT a collage. Keep all important text and the complete logo comfortably within an 80 px-equivalent safe margin.

BRAND REFERENCES: reference 1 is the actual official Melodia app icon: preserve that precise single musical-note silhouette and vivid green, do NOT redesign it, substitute a double note, or make a Spotify-like mark. Reference 2 is the approved landing page, supplied ONLY for brand typography, black/green palette and editorial mood; do NOT copy the website layout, browser header, player, or screenshot. The brand headline has just been explicitly approved by the owner: 'Tu música. A tu manera.' This MUST remain the main headline. Do not replace it with 'Descarga música gratis'.

ART DIRECTION: a striking, premium minimalist music-launch poster. Deep true-black background, restrained emerald accents exactly #2EE56B, warm-white type. Sophisticated Manrope-like geometric typography, excellent kerning, confident asymmetric editorial composition, generous negative space. The central/bottom visual is a beautiful sculptural pair of unbranded graphite over-ear headphones in controlled studio lighting, with a single elegant translucent emerald ribbon of sound passing through the earcups. Tactile matte graphite, restrained polished details, subtle green edge light. This is a CONCEPTUAL MUSIC VISUAL, not a product hardware claim. Make it feel designed by an excellent music-brand art director, not a generic AI tech template. No excessive glow, purple gradients, particle explosions, extra floating objects, grids of cards, ornamental dashboards or visual clutter.

LAYOUT AND EXACT SPANISH COPY: At top, small official app mark and the brand word 'melodia.' On the upper left / upper half, a large two-line headline, first line warm white and second line green:
'Tu música.'
'A tu manera.'
Below it in clearly smaller but easily readable text:
'Descarga música gratis.'
'Escúchala sin conexión.'
Let the headphones occupy the center/lower part with clear separation from all typography, dynamic but balanced. At the bottom a restrained label:
'Para Android · Código abierto'
And an understated but clear call to action:
'Descárgala en GitHub'
At the very bottom a legible small responsible-use line:
'Contenido propio o autorizado.'

The brand and headline must be immediately readable at phone feed size. Spell every Spanish word exactly, including all accents. Include NO other words, made-up handles, emails, prices, testimonials or statistics. NO Google Play badge, Apple/iPhone device, Spotify/YouTube logo, fake Android app UI, fabricated app screenshot, or invented QR code. The app is free/open source and distributed on GitHub; do not claim unlimited content or rights to any music. This should be the finished Instagram announcement image, not a design board or presentation mockup.

Make ONE strictly localized typography correction to this finished Instagram launch poster. Preserve the exact 4:5 vertical composition, logo, headline, typography hierarchy, black and green palette, headphones, emerald ribbon, lighting, call-to-action button, all spacing and every other word. Do not redesign anything. In the small information line immediately above the green 'Descárgala en GitHub' call-to-action, replace 'Para Android · Código abierto' with the exact text 'App de música para Android · Código abierto'. This line must be clearly readable, fit within the existing safe left and right margins on a single line, and make it explicit that Melodia is an APP rather than a headphones product. Preserve ALL other Spanish text exactly, including 'Tu música.', 'A tu manera.', 'Descarga música gratis.', 'Escúchala sin conexión.', and 'Contenido propio o autorizado.'. No new elements, no phone UI, no badges. Output a clean finished vertical 4:5 poster, not an explanation.

exportacion.metodo: Pillow ImageOps.fit con LANCZOS; aspecto nativo prácticamente 4:5, sin cortar texto ni producto
